name: procedural-memory
description: Recall and execute proven registry artifacts through digest-, trust-, and health-gated reuse, or compile repeated CLI patterns into inert Functionize proposals without registering or running them.

interface.shortDescription: Reuse proven artifacts or compile inert proposals
interface.longDescription: Use one host-neutral skill for digest-, trust-, and health-gated registry reuse and a separate Functionize skill for redacted CLI-pattern mining, inert proposal generation, and digest-bound review. Proposal generation never grants registration, trust, approval, promotion, or execution authority.
